findings.evidence: PVAggregation.lean lines 141-145 vs 191-196, 146-151 vs 197-202, 152-162 vs 203-215 are identical tactic text; only lines 163-164 vs 216 differ. The docstring justifies two *statements* (the value-tracking one needs `windowPieceSum`) but not the copied *proof*.
findings.fix: Generalize the invariant to depend on the remaining list, `Q : List ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Prop`, with `h_piece : ... → Q [] l u` and a cons-glue hypothesis `Q [] a (t - r) → Qwin t → Q rest (t + r) b → Q (t :: rest) a b`; then `hasCauchyPVAt_along_sorted` instantiates it at `Q L l u := HasCauchyPVAt γ l u g s (windowPieceSum r p w b L l)` and the Prop-valued form at `Q _ l u := Q l u`, and the copied induction is deleted. summary: The new generic gluing induction in PVAggregation.lean is a verbatim copy of the existing hasCauchyPVAt_along_sorted induction rather than a shared lemma, and the 180-line assembly proof in OnCurve.lean repeats its plain-piece reasoning twice inside itself. Both are mechanical to factor, and the PR already demonstrates the right pattern in PiecewiseC1On.lean.
